glm-flash.profile: Strong for its cost: intelligence index 42 (about sol at high), agentic coding 33, lowest hallucination rate here (about 28%). Slow: measured here at a median of 11 s per model turn (p90 38 s), with long reasoning; about 13 min per benchmark task. Good for background research, audits, and routine implementation when time does not matter. Avoid it when a fast answer matters, including trivial tasks. Quota cost per task: about $0.25.

muse-spark.profile: Free. Intelligence index 48 (between sol at max and astra at medium), agentic coding 33, hallucination rate about 33%. About 165 tokens/s, but about 25 s before the first token and about 4 min per benchmark task. Good free option for background research, audits, and routine implementation. Free tier: can be slow or unavailable at busy times. Costs nothing (free tier).

luna.profile: Fastest model: measured here at a median of 4 s per model turn. Weakest on reasoning. Intelligence index by effort: low 21, medium 29, high 32, xhigh 34, max 37. Agentic coding (Terminal-Bench 4.0): low 0, medium 3, high 5, max 13. Hallucination rate about 84%, the highest here: it invents answers when unsure. Use it for trivial commands, listings, reformatting, and simple searches where tool output is the evidence. Not for implementation beyond trivial edits, debugging, design, or fact-sensitive research. Quota cost per benchmark task: low $0.004, medium $0.02, high $0.03, max $0.07.

sonnet.profile: Sonnet 5.5 is a substantial upgrade over Sonnet 5. Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index by effort: low 35.8, medium 40.7, high 46.7, xhigh 51.9, max 56.0. Terminal-Bench 4.0: low 20.7%, medium 29.8%, high 43.9%, xhigh 57.1%, max 63.6%. Trial candidate for bounded implementation, tests, and reviews at medium/high effort. Local latency is unmeasured: do not assume faster than Opus or Sol. Opus-low slightly exceeds Sonnet-medium on these benchmarks. Max uses substantially more output tokens; do not default to max. AA API cost per task: low $0.41, medium $0.59, high $1.08, xhigh $2.74, max $7.60; these are not subscription quota measurements. Claude evaluations use AA default-fallback configuration, which may differ from this bridge. Keep Opus for UI/UX as requested.

sol.profile: Balanced OpenAI model, fast in practice: measured here at a median of 7 s per model turn (p90 17 s). Intelligence index: non-reasoning 28, low 34, medium 40, high 43, xhigh 44, max 48. Agentic coding: low 9, medium 19, high 26, xhigh 30, max 44. Low effort is cheap and quick (about 40 s per task) with a much lower hallucination rate than luna (about 51%), so sol at low beats luna for research and routine edits. Use high or xhigh for multi-file implementation, and max for coding-heavy work when time is not critical. Two Codex accounts, so quota is plentiful. Quota cost per task: low $0.13, medium $0.25, high $0.38, xhigh $0.53, max $1.06.

opus.profile: Strongest model measured. Intelligence index: low 42, medium 51, high 54, xhigh 56, max 58. Agentic coding: low 31, medium 53, high 57, xhigh 60, max 60. Fast in practice: measured here at a median of 7-10 s per model turn (p90 about 30 s), about 90 tokens/s. Higher effort adds time: xhigh and max are much slower. Hallucination rate about 66%. Medium is the best value; high for subtle correctness; xhigh or max only for exceptional tasks. Uses Claude quota shared with the main session. Always pick opus for UI and UX design or implementation: the user requires it. Quota cost per task: low $0.55, medium $1.34, high $1.82, xhigh $3.46, max $5.98.

astra.profile: Strongest OpenAI model and the most reliable: hallucination rate about 45-50%, the lowest of the frontier models. Intelligence index: low 46, medium 50, high 51, xhigh 52, max 53. Agentic coding: low 42, medium 50, high 54, xhigh 60. Slowest model in practice: measured here at a median of 15 s per model turn (p90 65 s), about twice opus. Astra at low already beats sol at xhigh. Good for hard correctness, security, and fact-sensitive work when speed does not matter; when opus is usable and speed matters, prefer opus. Two Codex accounts. Quota cost per task: low $0.82, medium $1.54, high $1.73, xhigh $2.31, max $3.26, so about 6 times sol at the same effort. Reserve it for hard work.

fable.profile: Weaker than opus at every effort level, at about twice the time and cost. Intelligence index: low 47, medium 49, high 51, xhigh 53, max 53. Agentic coding: low 40, medium 45, high 52, xhigh 55. Slow: measured here at a median of 12-15 s per model turn (p90 up to 136 s). Has an extra weekly limit of its own. No measured advantage over opus; pick it only when opus is unavailable. Quota cost per task: low $2.37, medium $2.98, high $3.91, max $7.63.
